races.display_title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: NESWICK proved suited by the step up in trip when making a winning start to life in handicaps at Southwell and can defy a 2 lb weights rise with likely better still to come from this lightly-raced sort. Wolverhampton scorer Fiefdom also has relatively few miles on the clock and is feared most, while the handily-weighted Percy Jones and C&D winner Fair Dinkum can also have a say in this intriguing handicap. NESWICK FIEFDOM (IRE) PERCY JONES

races.display_title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Nursery
races.verdict: The 2 interesting ones PRIDE'S QUEEN and Hemustbeanangel are drawn on the outside, which isn't ideal, but they are still expected to come to the fore. Ready preference is for the Botti filly given her latest second can be upgraded quite a lot. Rocsane may keep on for a place. PRIDE'S QUEEN HEMUSTBEANANGEL (IRE) ROCSANE (IRE)

races.display_title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not a deep maiden so it could be worth chancing GREEN SPAIN , who didn't show masses on debut in France this summer but that was a pretty warm race and her pedigree and connections suggest she'll up her game. Uomo Valeroso showed enough starting out at Kempton to think he'll be involved, with Rhythm Runner , Gilded Outlaw and Sand On The Run interesting newcomers on paper. GREEN SPAIN UOMO VALEROSO (USA) RHYTHM RUNNER

races.display_title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict: DEFIANT DREAM took a step forward when runner-up at Nottingham last time and is weighted to go one better and gain a first success off just a 1 lb higher mark here. Fancied Angel didn't enjoy the rub of the green when a recent fifth at Wolverhampton and is next on the list with likely better to come. Last Dandelion and Past Passion appeal also and need considering in this open nursery. DEFIANT DREAM FANCIED ANGEL LAST DANDELION

races.verdict: On the back of a fair return to action for new connections, TEGGY LASSO is fancied to take a step forward here with a raft of engagements in the coming days perhaps a sign of intent. Twitch is an in-form rival with a good draw to exploit, while Lessay is back at a much more realistic level. TEGGY LASSO (IRE) TWITCH (NZ) LESSAY (IRE)

races.verdict: TAM LIN shaped well after an absence on his first start for Mick Appleby when a recent Southwell fourth, fading only late on, and looks the way to go here with that run under his belt. C&D scorer Rovinia is next on the list, while in-form maiden Orange Emperor and multiple course winner Dandy Khan can also play a prominent role. TAM LIN (IRE) ROVINIA ORANGE EMPEROR (IRE)

races.display_title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PROSEWRITER did well under the circumstances and looked a good prospect to boot when making a winning debut in a Southwell novice 4 weeks ago. Well-bred and open to improvement, he may well be up to defying a penalty and go 2-2. Gombey Rhythm cost plenty at the breeze-ups last year and the booking of Billy Loughnane signals intent ahead of debut. Baandee and Flag of Nations complete the dangers. PROSEWRITER (IRE) GOMBEY RHYTHM BAANDEE

races.display_title: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: ZAJAL hails from a fine family and showed plenty when chasing home one who is undoubtedly destined for pattern class in a Doncaster maiden on debut 32 days ago. He looks sure to progress and is fancied to confirm the promise of that run here. Manolin and Manitoba also shaped promisingly on debut and head up the dangers. ZAJAL MANOLIN MANITOBA

races.display_title: Join The Southwell Racecourse Corporate Club Handicap Chase
races.verdict: IMPERIAL BEDE has plummeted to a career-low mark after a quiet spell and the cheekpieces he wore for the first time when last successful are back on. He's interesting for an in-form stable, all the more so if there is strength behind him in the betting. Grain Trade should stay this far and is a player, while last year's winner Bravethewaves could be a force in new headgear. IMPERIAL BEDE (FR) GRAIN TRADE BRAVETHEWAVES

races.verdict: BEAU DE MAINE showed plenty - behind one who's since run well over hurdles - in a Market Rasen bumper on his debut last month, so he's an appealing candidate making a quick switch to jumping for a yard that continues in fine fettle. Popton Point won 2 of her 3 starts in the bumper sphere last season, impressing with her attitude, and is surely up to making her presence felt on her hurdling debut, while Uda Man Dan is an interesting newcomer given his useful Flat pedigree. BEAU DE MAINE (FR) POPTON POINT (IRE) UDA MAN DAN (GER)

races.display_title: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: NOBODY TOLD ME is selected to make a winning start for new trainer Dan Skelton, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Yourcardismarked has also been the subject of an interesting trainer change and support for him would make him a potentially dangerous opponent. Laplander should be up to doing something off this mark based on Flat ability, while it would also be no surprise were Cheap Sandwiches to prove a different proposition in handicaps. NOBODY TOLD ME YOURCARDISMARKED (IRE) LAPLANDER

races.display_title: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: IN THE PURPLE hasn't been seen since a C&D handicap success in February but he took that in the style of one who should have more to offer for a leading stable. The Boss Bear couldn't justify favouritism but still made a sound start for the James Owen yard at Plumpton 3 weeks ago and heads the many possible dangers along with Presenting Milan and Dan Skelton's Typhoon Warrior , who is bred to be suited by this longer trip. IN THE PURPLE (IRE) THE BOSS BEAR (IRE) PRESENTING MILAN (IRE)

races.display_title: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: GIMARIAS is the obvious one on the back of his good second to a progressive sort at Chepstow at the beginning of the month. The fact that The Brave Guy went off as short as 5/2 in a competitive race on his handicap debut suggests he's thought better than he showed on that occasion. The low-mileage Elusive Shine is one to monitor closely in the betting on his return from an absence for in-form Sam England. GIMARIAS (IRE) THE BRAVE GUY (IRE) ELUSIVE SHINE (IRE)

races.display_title: Bill Halley Outstanding Contribution Award 2026 Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: A few with chances but THE DUCKS WALK signalled he is ready to go in again when an excellent runner-up in a big-field handicap at Punchestown recently so gets the vote. Johnny Cakes didn't enjoy the rub of the green when third at Limerick last time and rates a big threat off a handy-looking mark, while El Arco and Talas Kera appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours. THE DUCKS WALK (IRE) JOHNNY CAKES (FR) EL ARCO (IRE)

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict: This doesn't look the strongest of bumpers, so LADY AURORA makes obvious appeal having joined Willie Mullins after running out an easy winner on her completed start in points. Found It should be capable of building on her opening effort under Rules at Punchestown in early-May, while Shuil Solas bumped into a good prospect on her penultimate outing and merits respect back in calmer waters. LADY AURORA (FR) FOUND IT (IRE) SHUIL SOLAS (IRE)
